newsitem.title: PUERTO RICO: Puerto Rico Muni Finance Agency sets $250 mln deal.
newsitem.headline: Puerto Rico Muni Finance Agency sets $250 mln deal.

text.p: The Puerto Rico Municipal Finance Agency will issue about $250 million of loan consolidation bonds the week of April 7, or the following week depending on market conditions, an official at the Puerto Rico Government Development Bank said.
Morgan Stanley & Co Inc is senior manager for the negotiated deal. The size could rise to over $300 million if a refunding is added, said Lourdes Rovira, executive vice president at the bank.

The agency is a subsidiary of the General Development Bank, which issues interim loans to 60 municipalities. The debts are then consolidated and the loans repaid when the agency issues the bonds, Rovira said.
